title: Sequence M2 Profile discovery draft review and promotion implementation
goal: Create exact M2 child Plans while keeping Target trust change composition selection CI activation publication and merge outside this program.
acceptanceCriteria: Four child Plan pairs cover inert discovery, StateRoot draft scaffolding, explicit review validation and portable promotion candidates.
Every child declares exact code and test paths, risks, dependencies, boundaries and stop/resume/recovery behavior.
No product code, Target, workflow, ruleset, installed selection, release or remote state changes occur in this planning checkpoint.
risks: A planning checkpoint could be mistaken for implemented or accepted Profile authority.
decisions: Use four ordered child checkpoints and keep every Target or remote apply operation separate.
validationCommands: Test-Json for all M2 implementation Plan JSON files
